DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 皆さんで集合写真を撮ります。こちらへお集まりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: We are taking a group photo. Please gather over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。公園の広報へ載る写真でしょうか。参加は続けたいですが、自分は掲載されたくありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 広報写真掲載は辞退し催し参加は続けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. Is this photo going in the park's publicity materials? I want to keep taking part, but I don't want my picture published.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you decline to appear in the publicity photo but want to continue participating in the event. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 広報用の写真です。写らないよう、撮影の間は別の場所でお待ちいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, it is a publicity photo. You can wait somewhere else during the photo so you won't be in it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。催しをやめて帰るのではなく、写真の間だけ外れて、終わったら戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退出でなく撮影のみ外れ終了後戻りたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I don't want to leave the event and go home. I just want to step out for the photo and come back afterward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to step out only for the photo, rather than leave, and return when it is finished. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、こちらのベンチでお待ちください。撮り終わったらお声がけします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please wait on this bench. We will call you when we have finished taking the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。鞄は会場の椅子にありますが、必要なら今持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 指定ベンチへ待機し会場椅子の鞄回収要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll wait here. My bag is on a chair at the event, but I can get it now if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait on the designated bench and ask whether you need to collect your bag from the chair at the event. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま参加を続けるのでしたら、椅子のお荷物は後でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are continuing to participate, please check your belongings on the chair afterward.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。友人にも写真へ入らないと伝えます。私を呼んで連れて来ようとしているので、先に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 呼びに来る友人へ撮影辞退を先に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll also tell my friend that I won't be in the photo. They are trying to call me over and bring me here, so I'll let them know first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Tell the friend who is coming to get you beforehand that you are declining the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望は撮影担当にも伝えてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have also told the photographer about your wishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人にも伝わりました。撮影が終わるまでここで待ち、戻ったら次の活動の案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人伝達完了を知らせ撮影後戻り次活動案内を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. My friend knows now too. I'll wait here until the photo is finished, then return and listen to the instructions for the next activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your friend has been informed and that you will return after the photo to hear the instructions for the next activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、終わりましたらお呼びします。ご参加ありがとうございます。どうぞ楽しくお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will call you when we are finished. Thank you for joining us. Please enjoy yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅のスタンプをお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to use the station stamp?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この紙に押したいです。でも、裏に友人の住所があるので、別の紙にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所入り紙ではなく新しい紙へ駅スタンプを押したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I wanted to stamp this paper. But my friend's address is on the back, so I'd like to use another sheet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to put the station stamp on a fresh sheet rather than the one with an address on it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに無記入の紙があります。一枚お使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is some blank paper here. Please take a sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。上と下が分かりません。この持ち手の矢印を上に向ければよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙を受取り持ち手矢印と押印向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I can't tell which way is up. Should I point the arrow on this handle upward?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Accept the paper and ask about the arrow on the handle and the orientation of the stamp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、矢印を上にして押せます。試し押しには、こちらの紙をどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, you can stamp with the arrow pointing up. Please use this paper for a test impression.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず試します。星の絵が上になりました。同じ向きで、新しい紙にも押します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 試押しで絵の上下を確認して本番を押すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll try it first. The star picture came out at the top. I'll stamp the fresh paper the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked the picture's orientation with a test impression and will now stamp the final sheet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙が動かないように、端を押さえてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please hold the edge of the paper so it doesn't move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 押せました。下に日付を書いて、旅行のノートへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 押印でき日付記入とノート収納を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've stamped it. I'll write the date underneath and put it in my travel notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have made the impression and will write the date and put it in your notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: インクが乾くまで、少し広げておいてくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please leave it spread out for a little while until the ink dries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。すぐ折らず、このまま乾かします。友人の住所がある紙は、自分で持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: インク乾燥を待ち住所紙を持帰ると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. I won't fold it straight away; I'll leave it like this to dry. I'll take the paper with my friend's address home myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the ink to dry and take the paper with the address home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、旅の思い出をお楽しみください。お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please enjoy your travel keepsake. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 作品と題名札をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have the artwork and its title label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの絵を持ってきました。札はまだ書いていません。子どもが決めた題名を入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供の絵と未記入札を示し本人題名を入れたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've brought my child's drawing. I haven't filled in the label yet. I'd like to use the title my child chose.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the child's drawing and the blank label and say that you want to use the child's own title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 題名はどのような言葉でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「雨のあとの道」です。私は「虹」と書こうと思いましたが、本人は道を描いたと言っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人題名雨のあとの道と親の案の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is 'The Road After the Rain.' I was going to write 'Rainbow,' but my child says the drawing is of a road.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the child's title, 'The Road After the Rain,' and the parent's suggestion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、題名の欄に「雨のあとの道」とお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then please write 'The Road After the Rain' in the title field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書きました。作者は子どもです。付き添いの私の名前は、作者の欄には入れませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 題名を記入して作者は子供か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've written it. My child is the artist. I shouldn't put my name in the artist field just because I'm accompanying them, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Fill in the title and confirm that the child is the artist. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。連絡先の欄には、連絡を受ける方のお名前をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. In the contact field, please write the name of the person who will receive communications.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡は私が受けます。作者には子どもの名前、連絡先には私の名前と番号を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡担当の親と作者の子供を各欄へ記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll be the contact. I'll write my child's name under artist, and my name and number under contact information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Enter the parent as the contact and the child as the artist in the respective fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 絵と札を合わせて、題名をもう一度お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put the drawing and label together and check the title once again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 子どももこの題名でよいと言っています。絵の上下をそろえて、札と一緒にお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 子供の同意と上下確認後に絵札を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: My child also says this title is fine. I'll make sure the drawing is the right way up and hand it in with the label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Submit the drawing and label after confirming the child's agreement and the orientation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確かにお預かりしました。展示が楽しみですね。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have received them. The exhibition will be exciting. Please have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お呼びになりましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: トイレへ行きたいです。点滴の台もあるので、一人で動く前に来ていただきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 点滴中のトイレ希望で自己移動前に看護師を呼んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to go to the toilet. I also have an IV stand, so I called you before trying to move on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to use the toilet while on an IV and called the nurse before moving by yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いまの状態を確認します。お荷物はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check how you are now. Where are your belongings?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: かばんを膝に置いています。これも持って歩くと、台を扱う手が空きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 膝のかばんで台を扱う手が空かないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My bag is on my lap. If I carry it while walking, I won't have a free hand to handle the stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the bag on your lap leaves you without a free hand to handle the stand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: かばんは、この椅子へ置きましょう。必要な物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's put the bag on this chair. Is there anything you need from it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいタオルを取りたいです。それだけ取り出して、かばんを椅子へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: タオルのみ取り出しかばんを椅子へ置くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like my small towel. I'll take just that out and put the bag back on the chair.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take out only the towel and put the bag on the chair. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、移動の準備が整ったら私がご一緒します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will accompany you once you are ready to move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。戻った時も、この椅子で続きを受けるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 付き添いを頼み戻る場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. When I come back, will I continue my treatment in this chair too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to be accompanied and ask where you should return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お戻りになったら、こちらへご案内します。まず、一緒に移動しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you return, I will guide you here. First, let's move together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。タオルを取り、かばんを置きました。点滴の台の動かし方も見ていただきながら、付き添いをお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を置いたと伝え台の扱い確認を含む付き添いを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I've taken out the towel and put down the bag. Please accompany me and also check how I'm moving the IV stand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have put down your belongings and ask for assistance, including checking how you handle the stand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご一緒します。お困りのことは途中でもお知らせください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll come with you. Please tell me even along the way if you have any difficulties. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 先日の訪問について、ご連絡でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you contacting us about the recent visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。日本語の説明が難しかったので、もう一度お話を聞きたいです。家族も一緒に聞ける時間を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 訪問の説明を再度家族同席で聞く時間を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The explanation in Japanese was difficult, so I'd like to hear it again. Could we discuss a time when my family can listen with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a time to hear the explanation about the visit again with your family present. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 担当へ伝えます。家族の方は、いつご在宅でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll tell the person in charge. When will your family be at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 水曜は六時に帰ります。木曜は休みなので、午後も家にいます。私もどちらの日もいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人家族が在宅できる水曜夕方木曜午後を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They get home at six on Wednesday. Thursday is their day off, so they will be home in the afternoon too. I'll be there on both days as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give Wednesday evening and Thursday afternoon as times when you and your family can be home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当から、ご相談いただいた時間帯で連絡するようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll ask the person in charge to contact you during the time slots you discussed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。家族に全部任せるのではなく、私が聞いて分からない所だけ手伝ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人が聞き不明部分だけ家族に手伝ってもらうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I won't leave everything to my family. I'll listen myself and ask for help only with the parts I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will listen yourself and have your family help only with unclear parts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡は、どちらの番号へ差し上げましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Which number should we contact you on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の携帯へお願いします。この番号です。出られなければ、着信を見て折り返します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人携帯番号を示し不在着信時折返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: My mobile, please. This is the number. If I can't answer, I'll check the missed call and call back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Provide your own mobile number and say that you will return a missed call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所も、先日の訪問先と同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Is your address also the same as the place we visited the other day?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じです。この住所で、部屋番号も変わりません。まず担当からの連絡を待って、家族へ日時を知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所部屋番号不変と担当連絡後家族へ共有を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. It's this address, and the apartment number hasn't changed either. I'll first wait to hear from the person in charge, then tell my family the date and time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the address and apartment number are unchanged and that you will inform your family after the person in charge contacts you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お伝えします。それでは、ご連絡までお待ちください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that on. Please wait for us to contact you. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの箱をお送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send this box, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。姉へ送ります。中に父と母への贈り物も入っているので、取り違えないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 姉宛荷物内に父母の贈物があり区別したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's for my older sister. There are also gifts for my father and mother inside, so I want to make sure they don't get mixed up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the parcel addressed to your older sister contains gifts for your parents and you want to distinguish them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 外の宛先は、お荷物を受け取るお姉様のお名前ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The address on the outside will have the name of your older sister, who will receive the parcel, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。二人の名前を外へ並べるのではなく、姉に受け取ってもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外宛名は受取姉一人にすることを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I won't put both of their names on the outside; I'll have my sister receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that only the older sister receiving it will be named on the outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 中の包装に、渡す相手の名前を付けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can attach the intended recipient's name to each wrapping inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤い包みへ父、青い包みへ母と書いた札を付けます。色だけだと姉には分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 赤包み父青包み母の内札を付けると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll attach a label saying Father to the red package and Mother to the blue one. My sister wouldn't know from the colors alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will attach inner labels: Father on the red package and Mother on the blue package. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 札が外れないようにしてから、箱へ戻してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please make sure the labels won't come off before putting the packages back in the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 付けました。姉へ、赤は父へ、青は母へ渡してほしいと、短いメモも入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 札固定後に姉への配渡メモも入れると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've attached them. I'll also include a short note asking my sister to give the red one to Father and the blue one to Mother.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that after securing the labels you will also include a distribution note for your sister. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかの品物も、お入れになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Will you be putting anything else in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 姉への手紙が一枚あります。手紙とメモと二つの包みを入れ、外には姉の住所と名前を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手紙一枚とメモ包み二つと外姉宛住所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: There's one letter for my sister. I'll put in the letter, the note and the two packages, and write my sister's address and name on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm one letter, the note, two packages, and the sister's address on the outside. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、準備できましたら箱をお預けください。ご家族へ気持ちが届きますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please hand over the box when it is ready. May your family receive your warm wishes. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご希望の先月分の取引明細ができました。通帳と一緒に、こちらの封筒へお入れしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: The transaction statement for last month you requested is ready. Shall I put it in this envelope with your bankbook?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月分ですね、ありがとうございます。外は雨なので、紙の封筒に加えて袋にも入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 希望した先月明細の受領を確認し雨対策の袋も希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Last month's, yes. Thank you. It's raining outside, so I'd like to put it in a bag as well as the paper envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm receipt of the requested statement for last month and ask for a bag as protection from the rain too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お持ちの袋はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a bag with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 買い物用の袋があります。中は空で乾いているので、封筒ごと入れられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 持参買物袋が空で乾いていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have a shopping bag. It's empty and dry inside, so I can put the whole envelope in it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the shopping bag you brought is empty and dry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通帳も明細も封筒へ入りました。袋の大きさをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Both the bankbook and statement are in the envelope. Please check the size of your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ちょうど入ります。明細を外へ出したままにせず、封筒の口を折ってから袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通帳明細の封筒口を折って袋収納すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It fits just right. I'll fold over the envelope's opening and put it in the bag, rather than leaving the statement sticking out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will fold over the opening of the envelope containing the bankbook and statement and put it in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 傘をお持ちになる時、袋も持てそうでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will you be able to carry the bag while holding your umbrella?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。小さい袋なので、持ち手を手首へかけ、傘を持てます。かばんのふたも閉めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 小袋を手首へ掛け傘を持ちかばんを閉めると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. It's a small bag, so I can put the handles over my wrist and hold the umbrella. I'll close my other bag's flap too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the small bag over your wrist, hold the umbrella and close your other bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらに置いた物は、全部お取りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you collected everything you put here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通帳と明細と携帯を取りました。袋の口を上にして、寄り道せず家へ持って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通帳明細携帯所持と袋口上向きで帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've taken the bankbook, statement and mobile. I'll keep the bag's opening facing up and take it straight home without stopping anywhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have your bankbook, statement and mobile and will go home with the bag's opening facing up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、足元にお気をつけてお帰りください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please watch your step on your way home. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お返しになったカートに、こちらの商品が残っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: This item was left in the cart you returned.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あ、私が買った電池です。小さいので、袋へ入れ忘れました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: カートの残品が購入電池で袋詰忘れと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oh, those are the batteries I bought. They were small, so I forgot to put them in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the item left in the cart is the batteries you bought and forgot to pack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お買い上げの記録は、お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have a record of your purchase?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レシートがあります。こちらの下から二行目に電池が載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レシートの電池記載行を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have the receipt. The batteries are listed here, on the second line from the bottom.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the line listing the batteries on the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お会計した電池の表示と一致していますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: It matches the description of the batteries you paid for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。この四本入りを一つ買いました。買い物袋に入ったと思ってカートを戻してしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四本入一組購入とかごへ置いたままの経過を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I bought one pack of four. I thought they were in my shopping bag and returned the cart.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you bought one pack of four and how it was left in the cart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの一つをお返しします。ほかにもカートに残っていた物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll return this one to you. Was there anything else left in the cart?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見たところ、ほかにはありません。大きい品は袋にあります。この電池だけ手元で確かめたかったです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他残品なしと大物は袋にあると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: As far as I can see, nothing else. The large items are in my bag. I just wanted to check that I had these batteries.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm there are no other items left and the large items are in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 電池も袋へお入れください。レシートもお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please put the batteries in your bag too. Here's your receipt back as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電池とレシートを受け取りました。電池はかばんの小さいポケットへ入れます。見つけてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電池レシート受領と小ポケット収納と感謝を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the batteries and receipt. I'll put the batteries in my bag's small pocket. Thank you for finding them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm receipt of the batteries and receipt, say you will put them in the small pocket, and thank the staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。それでは、お忘れ物なくお持ち帰りください。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Please take everything with you. Thank you for shopping with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 時計をご覧になって、何か気になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there something that concerned you when you looked at the clock?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私の腕時計と、公園の時計が十分違います。今の時刻を確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 腕時計と施設時計の十分差から現在時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My wristwatch and the park clock differ by ten minutes. I'd like to check the current time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the current time because your wristwatch and the facility clock differ by ten minutes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 公園の時計は、今止まっています。修理の連絡をしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The park clock has stopped. We have contacted someone about repairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでしたか。さっきから長い針が動かないので、私の時計が進んだのかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長針停止を見て自己時計が進んだと思ったと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. The minute hand hadn't moved for a while, so I thought my watch was running fast.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that seeing the minute hand stopped made you think your own watch was fast. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お手元の携帯でも、時刻をご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you check the time on your mobile too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 確認できます。携帯も腕時計と同じです。友達との約束まで二十分あると分かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 携帯時刻が自己腕時計と同じで約束まで二十分と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I can. My mobile shows the same time as my watch. Now I know I have twenty minutes before meeting my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that your mobile and wristwatch show the same time and that there are twenty minutes until your appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 待ち合わせ場所までは、お時間がかかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Will it take you long to get to the meeting place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 歩いて十五分くらいです。もう少し座っていようと思っていましたが、今出ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 徒歩十五分なので休憩を終え出発すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: About fifteen minutes on foot. I was going to sit a little longer, but I'll leave now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that because it is a fifteen-minute walk, you will finish your break and leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お荷物をお忘れにならないよう、ベンチをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the bench so you don't leave any belongings behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 携帯とかばんを持ちました。友達にも今公園を出ると連絡し、時計の下で待たずに向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 携帯かばんを持ち友人へ出発を連絡すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've got my mobile and bag. I'll tell my friend I'm leaving the park now and head over without waiting under the clock.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have your mobile and bag and will let your friend know you are leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お待ち合わせへお気をつけて。よい午後をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then have a safe trip to your meeting. Enjoy your afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お出かけ先は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided where you are going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一人で青葉駅へ行きます。そのあと桜町駅まで歩き、帰りは桜町駅からこの駅へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一人で青葉駅へ行き桜町駅から帰る旅程を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm going to Aoba Station on my own. Then I'll walk to Sakuramachi Station and return to this station from Sakuramachi Station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your itinerary: going alone to Aoba Station and returning from Sakuramachi Station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内の青葉駅と桜町駅ですね。行きと帰りを一枚ずつご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You mean Aoba and Sakuramachi Stations on this guide. I'll prepare one ticket for each direction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。行きはここから青葉駅、帰りは桜町駅からここへ戻る二枚です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 行きと帰りの二区間を具体的に依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. Two tickets: one from here to Aoba Station, and one back here from Sakuramachi Station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify the two sections you need for the outward and return journeys. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 行きは二百七十円、帰りは三百四十円です。合わせて六百十円になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: The outward fare is 270 yen and the return is 340 yen. That makes 610 yen altogether.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 六百十円ですね。両方とも今日使います。まず青葉駅までの方を取り出せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 架空合計六百十円と当日利用を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: 610 yen, right. I'll use both today. I'd like to be able to take out the ticket to Aoba Station first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the fictional total of 610 yen and that you will use the tickets today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが行きの切符です。帰りの切符はこちらになります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the outward ticket. This one is your return ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 文字を確認します。青葉駅へ行く方は上着のポケットへ、桜町駅から戻る方は鞄へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 券記載を読み行き上着帰り鞄へ保管すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll check the writing. I'll put the one to Aoba Station in my jacket pocket and the one back from Sakuramachi Station in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read the tickets and say that you will keep the outward one in your jacket and the return one in your bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お帰りの駅へ着いたら、鞄の方をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you reach the station for your return journey, please use the one in your bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。二枚とも受け取りました。行きの切符だけを先に使い、帰りは歩いた先の桜町駅から乗ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二券受領と往路先使用復路別駅からの乗車を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I've received both tickets. I'll use only the outward one first, and for the return I'll board at Sakuramachi Station after walking there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm receipt of both tickets, using the outward one first and boarding at a different station for the return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、散策もお楽しみください。お帰りの切符も大切にお持ちください。よい一日を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then enjoy your walk too. Please keep your return ticket safe. Have a good day.
